description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
